## Checklist

- [ ] Small, focused change (one concern per PR)
- [ ] Tests added or updated, and `npm run check` passes
- [ ] No secrets, tokens or personal data committed
- [ ] New table or route has Row Level Security / authorisation checks
- [ ] Personal information handled per POPIA (minimised, consented, retention considered)
- [ ] No duplicated logic (DRY) and nothing built "just in case" (YAGNI)
- [ ] Docs or ADR updated if the architecture changed
